newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Unipetrol applies for PSE main mkt listing.
newsitem.headline: Czech Unipetrol applies for PSE main mkt listing.

text.p: Czech petrochemical conglomerate Unipetrol a.s. has applied for a listing on the Prague Stock Exchange's main market, following the merger of Kaucuk Group a.s. and Chemopetrol Group a.s., the PSE said on Wednesday.
It said that the listing, which would be one of the highest capitalised issues on the market, will be considered at a meeting of the PSE listing committee on August 8.
Trading in shares of Kaucuk and Chemopetrol ended after last Friday's session on the PSE, as the merger, approved earlier this year, was finalised under Czech law.
The petrochemical assets of the two former state companies were merged into the joint-stock company Unipetrol a.s., but the new mammoth company still needed to apply for a listing.
It was not known, until the PSE's statement on Wednesday, on which of the bourse's three markets Unipetrol would seek to have its shares traded.
The refinery assets were hived off in 1995 and merged to form Ceska Rafinerska a.s., a subsidiary of the new Unipetrol in which a western consortium of oil companies holds a 49 percent stake.

According to agreements by the companies' shareholders earlier this year, new shares of Unipetrol are to be issued at a 12-to-1 ratio for Kaucuk stock, while shares for Chemopetrol stock will be exchanged at an 11-to-1 ratio.
